reason: Captures whose payload contradicts their label. The audit found TLS ClientHello/ServerHello inside sessions labelled shadowsocks_native, and first payloads that are neither the labelled protocol nor TLS inside vmess_tls_stack and trojan_reality. The cause could not be established from per-session evidence, so they are excluded rather than relabelled: a wrong label is worse than a missing sample.
policy: Excluded from every training and evaluation corpus. Keep the captures; an exclusion is a claim about provenance, not a licence to delete evidence. Re-collect these conditions and compare before/after. The list is no longer hand-maintained: qc_protocol.py reproduces it, and it runs over every new corpus.
